brand.name: TERRYTORY Travel
brand.hero_subtitle: Destination intelligence, airline news, points & miles strategy, and the travel deals actually worth booking.

editorial.publication_description: a premium travel intelligence publication covering destinations, airline industry news, points & miles strategy, and genuinely worthwhile travel deals
rating_criteria: Travel Relevance & Reader Value (1-10): Is this about destinations, airlines, hotels, travel deals, points/miles, visas, or travel industry shifts that actually affect how people plan trips?
Actionability & Timeliness (1-10): Can a reader act on this (book, plan, avoid, save money)? Is it fresh news or an evergreen opportunity, not rehashed listicle filler?
Source Credibility (1-10): Is this from an established travel outlet, official announcement (airline, tourism board, government), or credible industry reporting?
editorial.research_focus: travel news or destination topic — current prices and deals, airline/hotel policy changes, seasonal timing, entry requirements, insider tips, and concrete booking advice travelers can act on
editorial.image_style: Prefer: sweeping destination landscapes, golden-hour cityscapes, airplane wing views, tropical coastlines, cozy European streets, airport terminals, luxury hotel interiors

monetization.disclosure: This article may contain affiliate links. If you book through them, we may earn a commission at no extra cost to you.
